lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag kedaaraa baanee kabeer jeeu kee ||
lines.translation: Raag Kaydaaraa, The Word Of Kabeer Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਊ ਬਿਬਰਜਿਤ ਤਜਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: usatat ni(n)daa dooo bibarajit tajahu maan abhimaanaa ||
lines.translation: Those who ignore both praise and slander, who reject egotistical pride and conceit,

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਹਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਤੇ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: lohaa ka(n)chan sam kar jaanahi te moorat bhagavaanaa ||1||
lines.translation: who look alike upon iron and gold - they are the very image of the Lord God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਏਕੁ ਆਧੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa jan ek aadh koee ||
lines.translation: Hardly anyone is a humble servant of Yours, O Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਬਰਜਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu bibarajit har pad cheenhai soee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Ignoring sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment, such a person becomes aware of the Lord's Feet. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਜ ਗੁਣ ਤਮ ਗੁਣ ਸਤ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੀਐ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: raj gun tam gun sat gun kaheeai ih teree sabh maaiaa ||
lines.translation: Raajas, the quality of energy and activity; Taamas, the quality of darkness and inertia; and Satvas, the quality of purity and light, are all called the creations of Maya, Your illusion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਹੀ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: chauthe pad kau jo nar cheenhai tinh hee param pad paaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: That man who realizes the fourth state - he alone obtains the supreme state. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਹਕਾਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: teerath barat nem such sa(n)jam sadaa rahai nihakaamaa ||
lines.translation: Amidst pilgrimages, fasting, rituals, purification and self-discipline, he remains always without thought of reward.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: trisanaa ar maaiaa bhram chookaa chitavat aatam raamaa ||3||
lines.translation: Thirst and desire for Maya and doubt depart, remembering the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਅੰਧਕਾਰੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jih ma(n)dar deepak paragaasiaa a(n)dhakaar tah naasaa ||
lines.translation: When the temple is illuminated by the lamp, its darkness is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਨ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: nirabhau poor rahe bhram bhaagaa kahi kabeer jan daasaa ||4||1||
lines.translation: The Fearless Lord is All-pervading. Doubt has run away, says Kabeer, the Lord's humble slave. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਬਨਜਿਆ ਕਾਂਸੀ ਤਾਂਬਾ ਕਿਨਹੀ ਲਉਗ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kinahee banajiaa kaa(n)see taa(n)baa kinahee laug supaaree ||
lines.translation: Some deal in bronze and copper, some in cloves and betel nuts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਬਨਜਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਕਾ ਐਸੀ ਖੇਪ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tahu banajiaa naam gobid kaa aisee khep hamaaree ||1||
lines.translation: The Saints deal in the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe. Such is my merchandise as well. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਆਪਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke naam ke biaapaaree ||
lines.translation: I am a trader in the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੀਰਾ ਹਾਥਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਛੂਟਿ ਗਈ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: heeraa haath chaRiaa niramolak chhoot gaee sa(n)saaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The priceless diamond has come into my hands. I have left the world behind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਲਾਏ ਤਉ ਸਚ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saache laae tau sach laage saache ke biuhaaree ||
lines.translation: When the True Lord attached me, then I was attached to Truth. I am a trader of the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਕੇ ਭਾਰ ਚਲਾਏ ਪਹੁਚੇ ਜਾਇ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: saachee basat ke bhaar chalaae pahuche jaai bha(n)daaree ||2||
lines.translation: I have loaded the commodity of Truth; It has reached the Lord, the Treasurer. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਨਿਕ ਆਪੈ ਹੈ ਪਾਸਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapahi ratan javaahar maanik aapai hai paasaaree ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the pearl, the jewel, the ruby; He Himself is the jeweller.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਆਪ ਚਲਾਵੈ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਆਪਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aapai dah dis aap chalaavai nihachal hai biaapaaree ||3||
lines.translation: He Himself spreads out in the ten directions. The Merchant is Eternal and Unchanging. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੈਲੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਪੈਡਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੋਨਿ ਭਰਿ ਡਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kar bail surat kar paidaa giaan gon bhar daaree ||
lines.translation: My mind is the bull, and meditation is the road; I have filled my packs with spiritual wisdom, and loaded them on the bull.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਖੇਪ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu nibahee khep hamaaree ||4||2||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: my merchandise has reached its destination! ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੀ ਕਲਵਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਰਿ ਮੂਢ ਮਤਿ ਉਲਟੋ ਪਵਨੁ ਫਿਰਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ree kalavaar gavaar moodh mat ulato pavan phiraavau ||
lines.translation: You barbaric brute, with your primitive intellect - reverse your breath and turn it inward.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਰ ਮੇਰ ਸਰ ਭਾਠੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਆਵਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: man matavaar mer sar bhaathee a(n)mrit dhaar chuaavau ||1||
lines.translation: Let your mind be intoxicated with the stream of Ambrosial Nectar which trickles down from the furnace of the Tenth Gate. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਭਈਆ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਦੁਹਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bolahu bhaeeaa raam kee duhaaee ||
lines.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, call on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੀਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਲਭ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਿਆਸ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: peevahu sa(n)t sadaa mat duralabh sahaje piaas bujhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O Saints, drink in this wine forever; it is so difficult to obtain, and it quenches your thirst so easily. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਚਿ ਭਾਉ ਭਾਇ ਕੋਊ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai bich bhaau bhaai kooo boojhahi har ras paavai bhaaee ||
lines.translation: In the Fear of God, is the Love of God. Only those few who understand His Love obtain the sublime essence of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਘਟ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪੀਆਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jete ghat a(n)mrit sabh hee mahi bhaavai tisahi peeaaee ||2||
lines.translation: As many hearts as there are - in all of them, is His Ambrosial Nectar; as He pleases, He causes them to drink it in. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਗਰੀ ਏਕੈ ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਬਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nagaree ekai nau daravaaje dhaavat baraj rahaaee ||
lines.translation: There are nine gates to the one city of the body; restrain your mind from escaping through them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੈ ਦਸਵਾ ਦਰੁ ਖੂਲੑੈ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਖੀਵਾ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: trikutee chhootai dasavaa dar khoolhai taa man kheevaa bhaaee ||3||
lines.translation: When the knot of the three qualities is untied, then the Tenth Gate opens up, and the mind is intoxicated, O Siblings of Destiny. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਭੈ ਪਦ ਪੂਰਿ ਤਾਪ ਤਹ ਨਾਸੇ ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: abhai pad poor taap tah naase kahi kabeer beechaaree ||
lines.translation: When the mortal fully realizes the state of fearless dignity, then his sufferings vanish; so says Kabeer after careful deliberation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਬਟ ਚਲੰਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਖੋਂਦ ਖੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ubat chala(n)te ihu mad paaiaa jaise kho(n)d khumaaree ||4||3||
lines.translation: Turning away from the world, I have obtained this wine, and I am intoxicated with it. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕੇ ਲੀਨੇ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਏਕੈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh trisanaa ke leene gat nahee ekai jaanee ||
lines.translation: You are engrossed with unsatisfied sexual desire and unresolved anger; you do not know the State of the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫੂਟੀ ਆਖੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਬੂਡਿ ਮੂਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: phootee aakhai kachhoo na soojhai bood mooe bin paanee ||1||
lines.translation: Your eyes are blinded, and you see nothing at all. You drown and die without water. ||1||
